text:
olivia-sales: Incoming security questionnaire from Solstice Health — they attached a CAIQ + a custom spreadsheet. Asking for an owner + ETA. POC kickoff 2026-04-15, will likely send PHI. Anyone take this?

kevin-pss: I can own intake. Please drop files and I'll triage. rough ETA for answers? :small_blue_diamond:

olivia-sales: Uploaded to /intake/solstice_2026/ and shared in Drive: https://drive.redwood.internal/solstice/intake (internal). If small, target 5 business days to complete baseline answers.

alex-sec: @kevin-pss I'll need to triage for PHI/data residency and KMS/BYOK requirements. Do they insist on on-prem or is VPC acceptable?

olivia-sales: They marked on-prem as a hard requirement for production, but POC can run in Dedicated with private networking. They explicitly called out KMS BYOK and SOC2 evidence.

alex-sec: OK. I'll prepare the security response pack. Quick question: will they send real PHI during the POC or only synthetic/anonymized records? This affects controls and the BAA.

sam-eng: For a Private/on-prem POC we'll need an infra lead + build of our offline package. If ephemeral, estimate 3 engineers ~4 days to build & test the image and runbooks.

kevin-pss: Noted. On pricing — should we quote a 2-week Dedicated trial (4x A100-equivalent) or propose Private trial? Sales favors Dedicated trial for faster delivery.

olivia-sales: Customer asked for cost estimate for a 2-week trial with 4 GPUs + private networking & basic support.

kevin-pss: I'll draft the pricing. @alex-sec, can you flag any compliance items that would require changes to the SOW (e.g., additional audit logs, DLP)?

alex-sec: If PHI is in-scope we need a signed BAA and SOC2 artifacts. Also recommend encrypt-at-rest with customer-managed keys (BYOK) and explicit retention controls. I'll attach prior BAA/SOC2 docs and open an internal intake ticket.

sec-bot: Created ticket SEC-INTAKE-547 and assigned to alex-sec, kevin-pss, sam-eng. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SEC-INTAKE-547

kevin-pss: Thanks — I'll start answers on the CAIQ baseline. Proposed ownership: Network & Encryption (kevin-pss), Data Protection & Legal items (alex-sec), Deployment/infrastructure runbook (sam-eng).

olivia-sales: Can we set an internal deadline to review the draft before sending to customer? Suggest 2026-03-28 to circulate draft.

alex-sec: 2026-03-28 works for me. :thumbsup:

sam-eng: Works for engineering. I'll add the infra runbook and deployment checklist to SEC-INTAKE-547.

olivia-sales: One more ask from the customer — they want a redacted screenshot of Console showing RBAC and a sample audit log snippet. Anyone have a sanitized screenshot we can use?

maria-devex: I can produce a redacted RBAC screenshot + sample audit snippet and post to the ticket by EOD.

kevin-pss: Great, thanks Maria. I'll keep customer updated and request their legal contact for the BAA.

olivia-sales: Appreciate it — I'll loop in the customer tomorrow with a short status update and ask for their legal lead. :pray:
